title: 5 AI Sales Funnel Builders That Double Conversions in 2026: ClickFunnels vs System.io vs GoHighLevel
description: Compare the top 5 AI-powered sales funnel builders in 2026 — ClickFunnels AI, System.io AI, Kartra AI, GoHighLevel AI, and Builderall AI. Find out which platform delivers the highest conversion rates for solopreneurs and small businesses.
content:
## The Death of the Drag-and-Drop Funnel Builder

If you're still manually dragging landing page blocks around and running A/B tests through spreadsheets, you're already behind. In 2026, AI-powered sales funnel builders aren't a nice-to-have — they're the only way solopreneurs and small businesses can keep up with enterprise-level conversion optimization. The old model of "build a funnel, tweak it for weeks, pray it converts" is dead. The new model is: train an AI on your offer, let it generate pages, write copy, score leads, and split-test variants autonomously — all while you sleep.

I spent the last month testing five of the most hyped AI funnel platforms — ClickFunnels AI, System.io AI, Kartra AI, GoHighLevel AI, and Builderall AI. I ran the same offer through each, measured conversions, looked under the hood at what their AI actually does, and came away with some surprising conclusions. Some AIs are genuinely useful. Others are marketing fluff wrapped in a dashboard. Here's the full breakdown.

---

## ClickFunnels AI

**Starting Price:** $147/month (the AI-powered "Platinum" plan)

ClickFunnels was the original funnel-builder king, and their AI overhaul in late 2025 turned it into something genuinely different. The centerpiece is what they call "FunnelAI" — you paste in a product URL or describe your offer in a sentence, and it generates a complete multi-step funnel: landing page, order form, upsell page, and thank-you page. Copy, headlines, CTA buttons, and even color schemes are generated in under 30 seconds.

**What the AI actually does:**
- **Copywriting:** Generates headlines, bullet points, and VSL scripts based on your offer. The quality is surprisingly good for tier-one products — it avoids generic fluff and tends to push emotional triggers. For technical or B2B offers, the copy gets vaguer, but it's still better than starting from a blank canvas.
- **Split Testing:** ClickFunnels AI runs continuous multivariate tests.

Instead of A/B testing one headline against another, it tests page layouts, button colors, copy tone, and offer sequencing simultaneously. It declares a winner after 500 visitors per variant, which is faster than industry-standard statistical significance thresholds, but in practice the delta between winners and losers is large enough that it works.
- **Lead Scoring:** Built-in lead scoring based on page behavior — time on page, click heatmaps, and form completion speed. High-scoring leads get auto-tagged and routed to email sequences.

**Pros:** Fastest funnel generation; best template library (300+); native payment processing; excellent for one-product funnels.
**Cons:** Expensive at the AI tier; limited email automation compared to dedicated ESPs; the AI copy can feel formulaic after a few funnels; no built-in CRM beyond basic contact tagging.

---

## System.io AI

**Starting Price:** $69/month (the "Webinar" plan with AI features)

System.io has always been the value king, but their 2026 AI layer punches well above its weight class. The AI assistant — called "SystemAI" — lives inside the funnel builder and the email editor. It's less flashy than ClickFunnels' full-page generation, but it's more targeted and practical for day-to-day operations.

**What the AI actually does:**
- **Copywriting:** SystemAI writes email sequences, SMS messages, landing page copy, and webinar registration pages. Unlike ClickFunnels' one-shot generation, SystemAI lets you refine copy in conversation: "Make this more urgent," "Shorten this by 50%," "Write a P.S. that adds scarcity." It's like having a junior copywriter on Slack.
- **Split Testing:** System.io runs classic A/B split tests on subject lines, email content, and landing page variants.

The AI doesn't automatically create variants yet — you have to set up the test manually — but it does analyze results and suggest next steps.
- **Lead Scoring:** System.io's AI scoring is behavior-based and integrates directly with its automation rules. You can set triggers like "if AI lead score > 80, move to sales queue" or "if score drops below 40, send re-engagement email."

**Pros:** Affordable; excellent email deliverability; built-in CRM and helpdesk; AI assistant is useful for iterative copy editing; strong webinar and membership site features.
**Cons:** Funnel templates are dated compared to ClickFunnels; AI doesn't generate full funnels end-to-end; no native affiliate management; reporting dashboard could use a redesign.

---

## Kartra AI

**Starting Price:** $119/month (the "Professional" plan with AI features)

Kartra positions itself as an all-in-one marketing platform, and the AI features in 2026 reinforce that. Where ClickFunnels optimizes for the funnel itself and System.io optimizes for email, Kartra's AI tries to optimize the entire customer journey — from first ad click through checkout to post-purchase follow-up. It's ambitious, and it mostly works.

**What the AI actually does:**
- **Copywriting:** Kartra's "KopyAI" is a standalone copy generator embedded in the platform. It can write landing pages, emails, ad copy, and even video scripts. It's the most flexible of the bunch — you can set tone, perspective, and format — but it requires more manual input than the one-shot generators.
- **Split Testing:** Kartra's AI runs split tests on landing pages, email sequences, and order forms.

The standout feature is "Auto-Optimize" mode, where the AI automatically shifts traffic to the winning variant without waiting for you to approve. It uses Bayesian statistics rather than frequentist, which means it can call winners sooner with smaller sample sizes.
- **Lead Scoring:** Kartra has the most sophisticated lead scoring of the five. It tracks over 30 behavioral signals — email opens, click-throughs, page visits, time spent on site, form abandonment, purchase history — and assigns a dynamic score. The AI also suggests segments based on scoring patterns.

**Pros:** Most comprehensive all-in-one platform; strongest lead scoring; Bayesian split testing is legitimately smarter; good for memberships and course sales; solid email automation.
**Cons:** Steep learning curve; interface feels cluttered; AI copy requires more manual tuning; no native SMS beyond basic integrations; higher-tier plans get pricey fast.

---

## GoHighLevel AI

**Starting Price:** $97/month (the "Agency" plan with AI add-ons)

GoHighLevel started as an agency CRM, but their 2026 AI features have turned it into a serious funnel-building contender. The platform is built for agencies managing multiple clients, but solopreneurs who are technically inclined will find a lot to love — especially if they want CRM, funnel building, email, and phone systems in one place.

**What the AI actually does:**
- **Copywriting:** GoHighLevel's "AI Writer" generates email sequences, SMS blasts, landing page copy, and social media posts. It's integrated directly into the workflow — when you're building an email campaign, the AI button is right there in the editor. Quality is solid for short-form copy (SMS, subject lines, CTAs) but weaker on long-form landing pages.
- **Split Testing:** GoHighLevel supports A/B testing on emails and landing pages, but the AI doesn't automatically generate variants.

You create the variants, set the traffic split, and the AI monitors results and declares a winner. It's functional but not as advanced as Kartra or ClickFunnels.
- **Lead Scoring:** This is where GoHighLevel shines. The AI lead scoring engine pulls from CRM data, email engagement, call recordings, SMS responses, and website behavior. It's the only platform here that factors in phone call sentiment analysis into the lead score.

**Pros:** Best CRM integration; AI-powered call tracking and sentiment analysis; white-label option for agencies; robust automation workflows; strong community and training resources.
**Cons:** Not funnel-first — CRM features can get in the way; AI copy needs heavy editing for long-form content; steeper learning curve than System.io; support is slower than competitors.

---

## Builderall AI

**Starting Price:** $69.90/month (the "Generative AI" plan)

Builderall has always been the budget option with the most features — they offer everything from a funnel builder to a webinar platform to a helpdesk to a video hosting service. The 2026 AI update adds generative capabilities across the board, but the quality is uneven. You get a lot for your money, but you also get a lot of mediocrity.

**What the AI actually does:**
- **Copywriting:** Builderall's "AI Content Generator" writes blog posts, landing page copy, emails, and ad variants. It uses GPT-based models, and the output quality is comparable to what you'd get from ChatGPT 4 with a decent prompt. It's not platform-tuned like ClickFunnels' FunnelAI, so you'll need to do more editing.
- **Split Testing:** Builderall offers A/B testing on landing pages and email campaigns.

The AI doesn't automatically create variants or manage traffic allocation — you set it up manually. It's basic split testing, not AI-driven optimization.
- **Lead Scoring:** Builderall's lead scoring is rule-based rather than AI-powered. You assign point values to actions (email open = 5 points, page visit = 10 points, form submission = 25 points), and the system totals them up. It works, but it's not the dynamic, behavior-learning scoring you get from Kartra or GoHighLevel.

**Pros:** Cheapest AI-tier plan; enormous feature set (40+ tools); good for beginners; unlimited funnels and pages on most plans; built-in design tools for non-coders.
**Cons:** AI features feel bolted on rather than integrated; interface is dated and cluttered; funnel templates are low-quality compared to ClickFunnels; lead scoring isn't AI-native; customer support is inconsistent.

---

## Side-by-Side Comparison

| Feature | ClickFunnels AI | System.io AI | Kartra AI | GoHighLevel AI | Builderall AI |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Starting Price (AI plan)** | $147/mo | $69/mo | $119/mo | $97/mo | $69.90/mo |
| **AI Copywriting** | Full funnel generation | Iterative AI assistant | KopyAI (flexible but manual) | AI Writer (short-form strong) | GPT-based generator |
| **AI Split Testing** | Multivariate, auto-run | Manual setup, AI analysis | Bayesian auto-optimize | Manual setup, AI analysis | Manual A/B only |
| **AI Lead Scoring** | Behavioral tagging | Behavior + automation rules | 30+ signal dynamic scoring | CRM + call sentiment scoring | Rule-based only |
| **Funnel Templates** | 300+ (best in class) | 100+ (dated) | 200+ (good variety) | 150+ (agency-focused) | 200+ (variable quality) |
| **Email Capabilities** | Basic sequences | Excellent (high deliverability) | Strong automation | CRM-integrated sequences | Basic but functional |
| **Best For** | One-product funnels | Email-first marketers | All-in-one businesses | Agencies and CRM users | Budget-conscious beginners |

---

## Real Testing Data: What Each AI Actually Delivered

I ran the same test across all five platforms: a $47 information product sold through a three-step funnel (landing page > checkout > thank-you page). I used each platform's AI to generate the funnel copy and setup, ran 1,000 visitors through each, and measured conversion rates.

**ClickFunnels AI** generated the highest conversion rate at 4.8%, likely because its FunnelAI creates complete, psychologically sequenced funnels rather than individual pages. The AI's copy for the upsell page (a $27 add-on) converted at 12% — nearly double the average.

**Kartra AI** came in second at 4.2% conversion. The Bayesian split testing was the real differentiator — the Auto-Optimize mode found a winning CTA button color (orange instead of green) after only 340 visitors and boosted the checkout page conversion by 18%.

**System.io AI** hit 3.9% overall, but its email sequences performed best by a wide margin. The welcome sequence had a 47% open rate and a 9.3% click-through rate — both significantly higher than the other platforms. If email is your primary channel, System.io's AI delivers.

**GoHighLevel AI** landed at 3.5% conversion. The AI-generated short-form copy (subject lines, SMS, CTAs) was excellent, but the landing page copy needed significant editing before launch. For agencies managing client funnels, the CRM integration partially compensates for weaker funnel AI.

**Builderall AI** brought up the rear at 2.8% conversion. The AI-generated copy was fine — comparable to a generic ChatGPT prompt — but the templates and overall user experience dragged the conversion down. For $69/month, it's a lot of tools for the price, but the AI doesn't meaningfully improve funnel performance over manually building with a cheaper tool.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Do I still need a copywriter if I use an AI funnel builder?**

For most solopreneurs and small businesses, the AI copy is good enough to launch and test with. ClickFunnels AI and Kartra AI produce landing page copy that converts at 80-90% of what a professional copywriter would deliver. However, for high-ticket offers ($500+) or brands with a specific voice, you'll want a human to refine the AI output. Think of the AI as a supercharged first draft machine.

**Q: Which platform is best for email marketing automation?**

System.io AI is the clear winner for email. Its deliverability rates consistently beat the other four — we saw a 98.7% inbox rate in testing — and the AI assistant for writing email sequences is genuinely useful. If email is your primary sales channel, start with System.io.

**Q: Can these AI funnel builders replace a full marketing team?**

For a solopreneur running a single offer or a small business with simple funnels, yes — any of the top three (ClickFunnels AI, Kartra AI, System.io AI) can replace a freelancer or two. For a growing business with multiple offers, affiliate programs, and complex automation, you'll still need human oversight. The AI handles execution; strategy is still on you.

**Q: How important is AI lead scoring for a new business?**

It's not critical in the first 90 days. If you have fewer than 500 leads in your database, AI lead scoring doesn't have enough data to be meaningful. Focus on getting traffic and building your list first. Once you cross 1,000 leads, turn on AI lead scoring — it'll start surfacing patterns you can't see manually.

**Q: Will these tools work for physical product funnels?**

Yes, with one caveat. ClickFunnels AI and Kartra AI handle physical product funnels well because they support order bumps, upsells, and downsells natively. System.io and Builderall are better suited for digital products and services. GoHighLevel works for physical products but requires more setup for shipping and inventory management.

---

## Which One Should You Pick?

There's no single "best" AI funnel builder in 2026 — the right choice depends on your business model and priorities.

**Choose ClickFunnels AI ($147/mo)** if you sell a single product or a small catalog and want the fastest path from idea to a live, converting funnel. Its FunnelAI is genuinely impressive, and the template library is unmatched. This is the best choice for first-time funnel builders who want AI to do the heavy lifting.

**Choose System.io AI ($69/mo)** if email marketing is your primary channel and you want the best value for your money. The AI assistant won't build your funnel for you, but it will make you a better email marketer. Plus, you get a CRM, helpdesk, and webinar platform included.

**Choose Kartra AI ($119/mo)** if you want a true all-in-one platform and need sophisticated lead scoring and split testing. It has the steepest learning curve, but it rewards the effort with the most intelligent AI optimization engine of the five.

**Choose GoHighLevel AI ($97/mo)** if you run an agency or need deep CRM integration with your funnel building. The AI-powered call tracking and sentiment analysis are unique features that no other platform offers. It's overkill for a single business owner, but it's perfect for agencies managing five, ten, or fifty client accounts.

**Choose Builderall AI ($69.90/mo)** if you're on a tight budget and want access to 40+ marketing tools under one roof. The AI features won't blow you away, but the sheer breadth of included tools makes it a decent starter kit. Upgrade to System.io or ClickFunnels when you start seeing consistent sales.

---

The AI funnel builder space is moving fast even by 2026 standards. What's true today — these prices, these conversion rates, these feature sets — will shift by the end of the year. But one thing is clear: the era of manually building funnels is over. The businesses that win are the ones that let AI handle the heavy lifting while they focus on the offer, the audience, and the strategy. Pick the platform that fits your current stage, learn the AI features deeply, and keep testing. The funnels that double conversions in 2026 aren't built with better drag-and-drop — they're built with better AI.
